notes: *more* is read as the preverb προσ-'s realization rather than as an `added` word; rule 106 forbids marking such a particle `added`, and LUK.19.16's προσηργάσατο → *hath made more* is the precedent.
Βλέπετε → *Take heed* heads on *heed*, the meaning-bearing complement of the light-verb rendering.
